claim: Patchline ships a curriculum module adopted by an external course with graded, gate-backed assignments. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the graded claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make external-curriculum-module-gate`.
